payload.title: Run a controlled model-backed DIP comparison
payload.description: Run identical preregistered coding and interrupted-session requirements trials using the same model/settings, isolated repositories, alternating with/without DIP order, external scoring, full costs/failures and honest limitations. Publish reproducible evidence and update existing benchmark documentation.
acceptance: Both arms use identical tasks, model and reasoning settings; baseline cannot receive DIP through global integrations.
Retain all trials and score outputs with predetermined external checks; distinguish within-session coding from fresh-session recovery.
Report success, elapsed time and available token usage without unsupported broad productivity claims.
